title: PkgSeek Linux Intelligence
description: Linux package, file, command, vulnerability, lifecycle, migration, and repository intelligence.
summary: Linux package, file, command, vulnerability, lifecycle, migration, and repository intelligence.
offersHint: Linux package, file, command, vulnerability, lifecycle, migration, and repository intelligence. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://api.pkgseek.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: search_tools
toolsPreview.description: Search curated Linux command-line tools.

toolsPreview.name: get_tool
toolsPreview.description: Get a sourced tool record, commands, flags and distribution mappings.

toolsPreview.name: resolve_install
toolsPreview.description: Resolve a tool and distribution to its package, real binary and install command.

toolsPreview.name: identify_binary
toolsPreview.description: Reverse an executable name to curated tools and packages.

toolsPreview.name: query_file_provides
toolsPreview.description: Find packages that contain a command or filesystem path.

toolsPreview.name: diagnose_linux_error
toolsPreview.description: Turn a package-not-found or command-not-found error into matching packages and install guidance.

toolsPreview.name: lint_command
toolsPreview.description: Statically inspect a shell command for unsupported flags and portability issues. The command is never executed.

toolsPreview.name: explain_command
toolsPreview.description: Explain and statically inspect a command using the Command Doctor knowledge base. The command is never executed.

toolsPreview.name: suggest_fix
toolsPreview.description: Return conservative, sourced guidance for command syntax or portability problems. The command is never executed.

toolsPreview.name: compare_distros
toolsPreview.description: Compare installation names and commands for a tool across Linux distributions.

toolsPreview.name: search_packages
toolsPreview.description: Search package names across repositories and distributions.

toolsPreview.name: get_package
toolsPreview.description: Get package metadata, dependencies, files and vulnerability evidence for one distribution.

toolsPreview.name: compare_package_versions
toolsPreview.description: Compare a package's versions and repositories across distributions.

toolsPreview.name: search_vulnerabilities
toolsPreview.description: Search cached CVE or CNNVD records, with optional distribution and severity filters.

toolsPreview.name: get_vulnerability
toolsPreview.description: Get a cached CVE or CNNVD record and distribution-aware affected-package evidence.

toolsPreview.name: check_release_lifecycle
toolsPreview.description: Evaluate whether a Linux distribution release is active, nearing EOL or unsupported under a CI policy.

toolsPreview.name: get_distro_lifecycle
toolsPreview.description: List cached lifecycle facts for a Linux distribution.

toolsPreview.name: compare_distro_releases
toolsPreview.description: Compare package additions, removals and version changes between two releases.

toolsPreview.name: plan_distro_migration
toolsPreview.description: Map packages from one distribution release to another and report missing or ambiguous replacements.

toolsPreview.name: get_package_history
toolsPreview.description: Trace indexed package version history for regression investigation.

toolsPreview.name: get_repository_health
toolsPreview.description: Read repository freshness, package counts and indexing health.

toolsPreview.name: get_context
toolsPreview.description: Get a token-efficient context pack with trust and execution guardrails for an agent.
